title: Patch Notes 1.27.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.27.0

Raiders, Patch 1.27.0 is rolling out right now. Please restart your game to download it.

Thanks for the constructive feedback you shared after Riven Tides launched. We're already looking into balancing adjustments to build on the changes that came with Riven Tides. We want to get this right, and once we're ready, we'll share all the details with you. Until then, enjoy Riven Tides and keep earning those merits.

The Corsaro Set and the Mutton Chops facial hair bundle are now available in the store, alongside the fixes listed below.

# ARC

* Fixed an issue where Turbine attacks couldn't be seen from a distance.

* Players can now drop whatever they're carrying and fight back against Ticks if attacked while holding an item.

* Adjusted how visible proximity mines are when deployed from the Turbine.

* Improved the quality of the Turbine's landing behaviour to reduce cases of poor landing zone selection, such as landing in treetops.

# Audio

* Fixed an issue where the Turbine's sound effects were drowning out other game sounds.

* Increased the range at which a Turbine can be heard.

* Fixed an issue where areas of Riven Tides with heavy vegetation had no audio feedback for movement or shooting.

* Fixed audio and animation issues that occurred when using items in very quick succession.

# Cosmetics

* Updated the Howdy emote so it can now be used while sprinting.

* Corrected the colors of the Rachetta outfit so they're more accurate.

# Maps

## Riven Tides

* Fixed the "Field Depot" POI not being counted toward the "Off the Radar" quest.

* Fixed several fruit baskets that were floating or buried.

* Fixed a location where players were able to fall through the floor.

## Stella Montis

* Fixed a wall with missing collision that let both ARC and players shoot through it.

# Utility

## Trigger 'Nades

* Fixed a recently introduced bug that let players trigger these grenades the instant they were thrown.

# Progression

* Fixed the Late Departure window so it now correctly displays the Catch Up Rewards information.
